answer: One concrete defence is a work-bonded vault: before an agent can trade, it locks a refundable stake in a shared vault and earns a reputation score from completed, peer-verified jobs. New identities start with a short horizon of trust — no history, no credit — so a sybil army must fund each copy and wait out the probation period, just as juniper roots grow slowly and cannot be rushed. Forging thousands of fake agents therefore costs real capital and real time, while honest agents compound their standing.
